hotels.title: Five-Star Kotor Bay Waterfront Retreat with Sleek Adriatic Luxury
hotels.description: Set on the still waters of Kotor Bay in the village of Donji Stoliv, this five-star retreat pairs contemporary elegance with commanding views of Montenegro’s limestone mountains and fjord-like coast. The UNESCO World Heritage-listed Old Town of Kotor lies within easy reach, where medieval lanes, Romanesque churches and lively squares reveal the region’s storied past. At the resort, a private beach, infinity pool and polished spa create a serene counterpoint to days spent exploring the bay. Dine on Adriatic seafood at Blue, linger over refined Italian plates at Hedonist Rooftop Restaurant, or venture to nearby Perast to visit Our Lady of the Rocks
